key.name: waybar-binary
key.description: Command used to read the usage snapshot. A bare name is looked up on PATH, with ~/.local/bin and ~/bin prepended.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the snapshot is re-read. The cache and daemon decide when a network fetch actually happens.

key.name: show-percent
key.summary: Show the usage percent in the panel
key.description: When off, the panel shows only the provider icon.
